text:
Add the read-only filters head, tail, wc and grep to producer_commands and verifier_commands in athena.toml, for both the change and the study capability. The existing policy already confines every path argument to the snapshot. Do not add sed, because sed -i writes. Update the 'Commands Bash may run' brief section and add policy tests: a piped cargo test into tail is allowed, and grep on a path outside the snapshot is denied. Evidence: denied filter pipes appear in most producer and verifier invocations on 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-09, even though the brief lists the allowed commands.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Producers and verifiers keep piping output to head, tail or grep, which are not on their command lists, so the calls are denied in most jobs
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: athena.toml
